spokenMeaning: Cara ngomong dijaga. Cara berpakaian dipikirin. You curate your words and your clothes minute by minute so nobody can judge them.
viewerTakeaway: Watching the true word get struck and replaced shows how exhausting self-monitoring is: the safe version stands, but the scar of what you erased never leaves.
visualMechanism: In-place word swap: the honest word in a real sentence is struck by a gold ha...

visualNarrative.action: Headline 'LU JAGA DUA HAL TIAP DETIK' fades up left; below it the first row label NGOMONG and the phrase 'gue bilang susah' reveal, SUSAH set in gold.
visualNarrative.meaning: The honest version exists first — speech is still true before the monitoring kicks in.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Gold word SUSAH sits solid at the end of an otherwise plain sentence under a small uppercase NGOMONG label.

visualNarrative.action: A gold hairline draws left-to-right across SUSAH and the word dims to 35% opacity, staying on screen as a ghost.
visualNarrative.meaning: Self-monitoring strikes the true word before it lands; the deletion leaves a visible scar, not a clean erase.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Gold strike line crosses SUSAH while the struck word remains faintly readable beneath it.

visualNarrative.action: The bland word 'oke' slides into the same slot on the same baseline; the struck 'susah' stays as a dim ghost behind the strike.
visualNarrative.meaning: The safe version stands in the position of truth — the sentence now reads curated, and the record of what was removed persists.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One slot holds both words: solid white 'oke' in front, gold struck ghost 'susah' behind it.

visualNarrative.action: Second row BERPAKAIAN reveals with 'gue pake berani', then repeats the identical action: strike draws across BERANI, it ghosts, 'biasa' slides into the slot.
visualNarrative.meaning: Appearance is curated by the exact same mechanism — repetition proves it is habitual hypervigilance, not a one-off edit.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Two parallel rows each ending in an identical gold strike scar, both slots now holding bland white words.

visualNarrative.action: Both rows hold with a small inward position shift (rows tighten toward the headline) while the gold scars stay lit.
visualNarrative.meaning: The frame tightens physically: performed identity is comfortable for no one, and the record of editing is permanent.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Static final frame: headline, two labels, two bland sentences, two gold strike scars, dark empty right third.
